title: visual_spec
description: Output of 06_VISUAL. Contract proposal: docs/visual-layer/contracts-proposal.md section 4.

job_id.description: editorial.jobs.id; existence is checked by code

model.description: model name, or not_reported when the stage used no LLM

created_at.description: ISO 8601 in UTC, with the Z suffix

insight_id.description: must exist and be ranked; checked by code. Id format is UNKNOWN

evidence_ids.description: each id must exist in verification and be VERIFIED; checked by code

grammar_id.description: a grammar of visual_library, or not_reported; membership is checked by code against the config (U17)

rationale.description: audit only; no stage reads it
